== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Helgard is a territory that can be accessed via [[Gates]] and serves as a location for [[Travelers]]. One specific area within this territory is known as the [[Tower of Winter]], which is characterized by extreme cold and features vast, glowing ice fields that create their own horizon. This particular floor is sparsely populated and contains quarters constructed from plain metal or stone, where snow can sometimes be found. Within Helgard, thirty-two floors have been identified so far. The name Helgard is also associated with several distinct individuals. A [[Grandmaster Helgard]] is a prominent figure described as a large, bearded man who is considered the most proficient [[Helgard Traveler]] in his city; he wears a blue cloak with white fur as a representative of the territory. There is also a horned, blue-skinned woman associated with Helgard who is accompanied by a large blue cat and moves within a personal flurry of snow. Additionally, the entity known as the [[Helgard Incarnation]] exists, possessing icy eyes that glow with blue-green light.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Known as the [[Tower of Winter]], Helgard is a location consisting of thirty-two discovered floors. During a period of war within its walls, the site is overseen by a Grandmaster. The tower's history is immortalized in a stained-glass window that portrays an ancient Overlord signing a peace treaty with the local natives. In more recent events, [[Valin]] stole the [[frozen horn]] from the tower, and a giant spotted on the plateau is believed to have originated from Helgard.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Helgard is an [[Incarnation]] associated with certain [[Travelers]] and a [[Territory]] that functions to collect and store information. This blue-skinned woman, characterized by white fur and curling horns behind her ears, possesses the ability to summon snow and freeze objects with a blue hand. Within her domain lies a multi-floored [[Tower of Winter]] protected by formidable guardians, and she was previously observed at the city gates months ago. Although [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] has kept her in reserve, she eventually pursued [[Leah]] and used black ice to form a jagged icicle aimed at [[Andra Agnos|Andra]].}}
